frozen_submission.scheduler_and_shell_generated_environmen: Slurm/SPANK may add scheduler variables such as SLURM_*, and Bash/torchrun may add their ordinary process-local variables. SLURM_CONF is the one deliberately exported cluster-routing value. No omitted login-environment variable may be backfilled.
frozen_submission.rationale: env -i removes caller-side shell, loader, SBATCH, function, and Python hooks and then defines exactly eight values: seven wrapper/runtime values plus the canonical root-owned SLURM_CONF path required for AGA client configuration discovery. Plain --export=ALL propagates those eight clean caller values and prevents implicit login-environment retrieval. NIL also avoids retrieval but cannot export the required values; NONE, an explicit variable list, and ALL with explicit suffixes trigger retrieval. Leaving PYTHONWARNINGS absent preserves normal CPython filters: the frozen ExperimentalFeatureWarning UserWarning is emitted once, while unrelated DeprecationWarnings remain suppressed.
